# Signed raw action gradients by trajectory outcome

Each component is mean ± standard error of ∂Q/∂a in native policy-action coordinates before critic standardization. Q is predicted success probability. Means weight recorded chunks equally; standard errors cluster all chunks and branches by originating episode. Known-invalid slots contribute zero. Columns follow the recorded seven-dimensional action order.
